items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was a corner player, tall. Now what relation is he to Theodore, Raleigh? That's his daddy. [INTERVIEWEE] I know that boy Wayne... Yeah, that's his pa.

ctx.x: Well he was a corner player. He was a corner player.
He was a corner player, tall. Now what relation is he to Theodore, Raleigh? That's his daddy.
I know that boy Wayne, he was a little bit of a baby. Yeah, that's his pa. Daddy could play good, but he was a good player. But old good middles, you know. And he was a middlesbrunner for his father.
